name: How do I ensure the design of my custom built-in matches my home's style?
description: Ensure your built-in matches your home by considering existing trim, architectural details, and selecting complementary materials and finishes.

mainEntity.name: How do I ensure the design of my custom built-in matches my home's style?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure your custom built-in design harmonizes with your home's style, consider elements like existing trim, molding profiles, and architectural details. We recommend providing photos of your current decor and discussing your home's overall aesthetic with our designers. Choosing complementary materials, finishes, and hardware that echo other features in your home will help create a cohesive and integrated look that feels original to the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure your built-in matches your home by considering existing trim, architectural details, and selecting complementary materials and finishes.
